name: American Padlock Bypass Driver
description: Several American Lock series padlocks have a design vulnerability where a shaped driver inserted into the keyway and pressed against the locking mechanism releases the shackle without picking. This is a direct bypass of the lock mechanism and is significantly faster than picking. American Lock padlocks are extremely common on utility gates, HVAC equipment enclosures, and dumpster areas at commercial targets.

blue.det: Padlock opens without key; driver tool visible; camera footage.
blue.cm: Upgrade to Series 5 or solid-body American padlocks not affected by bypass; shrouded shackle padlocks; electronic locks for high-security applications.
